questions.question: Find the average of first 30 multiples of 7.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The first multiple of 7 is = 7

Second multiple of 7 is = 7 × 2 = 14

Similarly 30th multiple of 7 is = 7 × 30 = 210

So,

AP is 7 + 14 + ……. + 210

Average of AP = (First term + Last term)/2

⇒ (7 + 210)/2

⇒ 217/2

⇒ 108.5

**∴ The correct answer is 108.5.**

questions.question: In the triangle, ABC, the internal bisector of angle A meets the side BC at D. If BD = 7.5 cm and BC = 9 cm. Then, calculate the value of AB: AC.
questions.solution:

BD = 7.5 cm

And, BC = 9 cm

questions.question: If 170% of a number added to 66, then the result becomes equal to twice of the number. What is the number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

170% of a number added to 66,

the result becomes equal twice

**Calculation:**

Let the number be = x

According to the question

⇒ x × 170/100 + 66 = 2x

⇒ 17x/10 + 66 = 2x

⇒ 2x - 17x/10 = 66

⇒ 3x/10 = 66

⇒ x = 220

**∴ The correct answer is 220.**

questions.question: The ratio of Mohit’s and Sunil’s age at present is 7 : 9. Mohit is 4 years younger than Sunil. What will be the ratio of Mohit’s age and Sunil’s age after 6 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of Mohit and Sunil’s present age = 7 : 9

**Calculation:**

Let Mohit’s present age is 7x and Sunil’s present age is 9x

According to the question,

⇒ 9x - 7x

⇒ 2x = 4

⇒ x = 2

So,

The present age of Mohit

⇒ 7 × 2

⇒ 14

And,

The present age of Sunil

⇒ 9 × 2

⇒ 18

After 6 years, the ratio of their age will be

⇒ 14 + 6 : 18 + 6

⇒ 20 : 24

⇒ 5 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is X and one of the number is 38. If 38 is replaced with 19, then what will be the new average?

questions.question: Simple interest on a sum of Rs. 67400 for 14 months is Rs. 4718. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 67400

Time (T)= 14/12 years

Simple interest (SI) = Rs. 4718

**Concept used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4718 = (67400 × R × (14/12))/100

⇒ R = 4718 × 100 × 12/(67400 × 14)

⇒ R = 6%

**∴ The rate of interest is 6%.**

questions.question: On selling 25 shirts, a retailer earns profit equal to the cost price of 8 shirts. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When profit is given in terms of **Cost Price (CP)**, use the direct ratio:

Profit % = (Units of Profit ÷ Units Sold) × 100

Profit % = (8 ÷ 25) × 100

Profit % = 8 × 4 = 32%

**∴ The correct answer is 32%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e92e5c30116a6287b71dd21e30eaada006bb0b8f9d8cc217adc25ddfbd0944e5.png] 

**Given:**

Quantity of shirts sold = 25

Profit = Cost Price of 8 shirts

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = (Total Profit ÷ Total Cost Price) × 100

⇒ Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 shirt = ₹1

⇒ Total **Cost Price** of 25 shirts = 25 × 1 = ₹25
⇒ **Profit** earned = CP of 8 shirts = 8 × 1 = ₹8
⇒ Profit % = (8 ÷ 25) × 100
⇒ Profit % = 8 × 4
⇒ Profit % = 32%

**∴ The correct answer is 32%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit in terms of Selling Price

If profit is equal to the **Selling Price (SP)** of 'n' items on selling 'x' items, then Profit % = [n ÷ (x − n)] × 100.

Relationship between CP, SP and Profit %

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit %) ÷ 100. Conversely, CP = [SP × 100] ÷ (100 + Profit %).

Loss in terms of Cost Price

If loss is equal to the CP of 'n' items on selling 'x' items, then Loss % = (n ÷ x) × 100.

questions.question: What will be the net discount (in percentage) for two successive discounts of 30% and 20%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The successive discounts is 30% and 20%.

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

**Calculation:**

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

⇒ X = 30%, Y = 20%

⇒ 30 + 20 - 600/100

⇒ 44%

**∴ The single equivalent discount is 36%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Calculation:**

SP = MP - (Discount %/100) × MP

Let the marked price be Rs. x

New price after discount = x - (30/100) × x

⇒ Rs. 0.7x

Price after successive discount = 0.7x - (20/100) × 0.7x

⇒ Rs. 0.56x

Total discount = x - 0.56x

⇒ 0.44x

Discount% = (Discount)/MP × 100

Discount % = (0.44x)/x × 100

⇒ 44%

**∴ The correct answer is 44%.**

questions.question: If x = 1.1, then what is the value of sqrt {4{{{x}}²} - 4{{x}} + 1}?

x = 1.1

**Calculation:**

⇒ √(4x² - 4x -1)

⇒ √(2x - 2 × 2x × 1 + 1²)

⇒ √(2x - 1)² 

⇒ 2x - 1

By putting the value x = 1.1 we get,

⇒ (2 × 1.1) - 1

⇒ 2.2 - 1 

⇒ 1.2

**∴ The correct answer is 1.2.**

questions.question: Manish can complete a work in 21 days and Karan can complete the same work in 28 days. If both together work for 7 days, then what fraction of the total work is left?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work (LCM of **21** and **28**) = **84 units**.

Combined Efficiency of **Manish** and **Karan** = 4 + 3 = **7 units/day**.

Work completed in **7 days** = 7 × 7 = **49 units**.

Remaining work = 84 − 49 = **35 units**.

Fraction of total work left = 35 / 84 = **5/12**.

**∴ The correct answer is 5/12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Manish** completes work in **21 days**; **Karan** completes work in **28 days**; They work together for **7 days**.

**Formula:** **Efficiency** = Total Work ÷ Time; **Remaining Fraction** = Remaining Work ÷ Total Work.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work (LCM)**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **Manish**

⇒ Total Efficiency of **(Manish + Karan)** = 4 + 3 = **7 units/day**

⇒ Work done in **7 days** = 7 × 7 = **49 units**

⇒ Remaining work = 84 − 49 = **35 units**

⇒ Fraction of work left = 35 / 84 = **5/12**

**∴ The correct answer is 5/12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is always considered as **1 unit** in fraction-based methods or the **LCM** of days for efficiency-based methods.

Combined Rate of Work

If person A takes x days and B takes y days, their 1-day work together is **(1/x + 1/y)**.

Work Left Formula

Fraction of work left = **1 − (Work Done / Total Work)** or simply (Remaining Units / Total Units).</p

questions.question: The length of the diagonal and the breadth of a rectangle is 13 cm and 5 cm respectively. Calculate its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal of rectangle = 13 cm

Breadth of rectangle = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5da6ef9bfe34986a7f92451bc565fcbb36a24c65f0f9aac3a16c14f52fa89663.png] 

Diagonal of the rectangle AC = 13

And, the breadth of a rectangle is BC = 5

Using Pythagoras theorem,

AB² = AC² - BC²

⇒ AB² = 13² - 5²

⇒ AB² = 169 - 25

⇒ AB² = 144

⇒ AB = 12 cm

Area of rectangle = l × b = AB × BC = 12 × 5 = 60 cm² 

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm2 .**

questions.question: What is the sum of the measures of all the interior angles of a regular polygon of 5 sides?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Sum of the Interior angle of a regular polygon whose side is n = (n - 2) × 180

**Calculation:**

Sum of the measures of all the interior angles = (5 - 2) × 180° = 3 × 180° = 540°

**∴ The correct answer is 540°**

questions.question: The volume of a sphere is 179.67 cm³. Find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Volume of a sphere = 179.67 cm3

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × πr³

**Calculation:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × πr3

⇒ 179.67= 4/3 × (22/7) × r³

⇒ r³ = 179.67 × 21/88 

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

So, diameter (d) = 3.5 × 2 = 7 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 7 cm.**
